title: The merchant asks you to “verify” Apple Pay
scenario: A merchant terminal declines your phone payment twice. The clerk says foreign wallets sometimes need manual verification and asks you to open your wallet settings while they scan a QR code shown on their terminal.

answers.A: Scan the QR but cancel if it asks for a password, recovery key or device-management permission.
answers.B: Stop and use another verified payment method or merchant terminal without changing wallet security settings from a QR prompt.
answers.C: Ask for a standard chip-and-PIN/card transaction and keep control of your device.

explanation: Payment failure can be used to push you into an unrelated security flow. A merchant should not need access to wallet recovery or device settings.
proTip: A declined payment is not a request to reconfigure your identity.
